hlg_58bd0caca4f4bc30_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Implement an Anonymous Estimation Interface that renders a user-facing session token-based UI for team members to input estimates without revealing identities, while preserving session integrity and enabling anonymous aggregation of estimates.
hlg_58bd0caca4f4bc30_001.rationale: llg_001 introduces the capability to render a user interface for anonymous estimation using session tokens to ensure identity concealment. This capability is the sole functional scope provided and must be preserved explicitly in the reconstructed goal, as no other LLGs are supplied. The reconstructed goal explicitly includes the UI rendering, session token mechanism, anonymity, and the implied aggregation of estimates — all derived directly from llg_001.

hlg_eca1ad8fec0452f0_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable team members to submit individual task estimates and aggregate them into a visual consensus view for transparency and decision-making.
hlg_eca1ad8fec0452f0_001.rationale: llg_001 enables a team member to submit a numerical or relative estimate via an API with validation and anonymized storage, establishing the input mechanism. llg_002 aggregates these submitted estimates and displays a visual summary (e.g., histogram, median, or range) via an API to promote consensus and transparency, defining the output and collaborative outcome. Together, they form a complete scope of estimate submission and collective visualization, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Allow Team Member to Submit Estimate

hlg_6223ef1ae8a63a6d_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable real-time collaborative estimation with anonymized peer visibility, discussion threads, and immediate visual feedback via API-driven interactions.
hlg_6223ef1ae8a63a6d_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to provide immediate visual feedback on submitted estimates via API; llg_002 adds the capability to allow team members to view anonymized estimates without identity disclosure via API; llg_003 adds the capability to support discussion threads tied to estimates, including notifications and collaborative annotations via API. Together, these form a system for real-time, anonymized, and discussion-enabled collaborative estimation.
source_low_level_goal_ids: Allow Team Member to View Others' Estimates

hlg_5e7a3196b0bbf0c7_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Implement a token-based anonymous estimation system for sprint planning sessions that generates secure session tokens, renders a token-protected UI, validates tokens and session state, accepts anonymous estimate submissions, aggregates estimates into anonymized summaries, and displays results to the Scrum Master for facilitation.
hlg_5e7a3196b0bbf0c7_001.rationale: llg_001 enables secure token generation for anonymity and session isolation; llg_002 provides a UI for token-validated input; llg_003 ensures only valid tokens authorize submissions; llg_004 allows anonymous submission of estimate values; llg_005 aggregates estimates while preserving anonymity; llg_006 delivers anonymized results to the Scrum Master for decision-making. Together, these form a complete anonymous estimation workflow with token security, UI, validation, submission, aggregation, and result display.
